parameters.formTitle: New role from a client call
parameters.formDescription: Paste the full call transcript. The AI drafts a job description and sends it to Slack for approval. Nothing is sent to the client until a recruiter approves.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ title: $json.title, client_name: $json.client_company, transcript: $('New role form').first().json['Call transcript'], job_description: $json.job_description, must_haves: $json.must_haves, nice_to_haves: $json.nice_to_haves, jd_status: 'pending_approval' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ jd_status: 'approved', approved_by: 'Slack approval', approved_at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

parameters.text: =:white_check_mark: Approved: *{{ $('Parse JD').first().json.title }}* for {{ $('Parse JD').first().json.client_company }} (role #{{ $('Save role').first().json.id }}). It is now an open role and ready to share with the client.
=:x: Rejected: *{{ $('Parse JD').first().json.title }}* (role #{{ $('Save role').first().json.id }}). Nothing was sent. Submit the transcript again to get a new draft.
